title: Pixel Studio 2
notes: Pixel Studio 2: select a box, draw a lasso or use the magic wand, then copy, cut, paste, move, nudge, flip, rotate, crop or invert it.…
New tools: dithered gradient, shade (lightens or darkens with a little hue shift), dither brush and pixel text
Pixel-perfect pencil lines, a round brush, and fill every pixel of a colour at once (Shift+click)
Hold Shift for straight and 45-degree lines, squares and circles. Alt+click takes a colour with any tool
